ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Undergraduate Research Laboratory In this apprenticeship-style, hands-on laboratory, students discover what it means to be a computational researcher. Students will learn to i) Pose testable research questions; ii) Write competitive grant proposals; iii) Create novel solutions using software and/or hardware; iv) Draw valid scientific conclusions; and v) Present and publish results, conclusions and other materials. This team-based undergraduate-only course requires the consent of the instructor.
